summary: P1 ordering/adjacency unification and P2 authoritative fail-closed coverage.

p1.basis_contract: residue_source_order_key() is now the single canonical per-chain basis (label_seq_id > source_order > residue number), shared by tier1_measurements._order_residues and coord_math.get_sequential_residues, so the two consumers cannot order differently.
p1.insertion_continuity: _numeric_adjacent() requires consecutive insertion codes (abs(rank diff)==1): 184A->184C rejected (184B missing), 184A->184B accepted, 184A<->blank accepted.
p1.gap_accounting: LAW-110 sets unknown_gap_found when a source-consecutive pair is numbering-incompatible (e.g. chain 1,2,4,5), returning NOT_MEASURED instead of an unqualified PASS from the other measured pairs.
p1.tests: added: skipped insertion code, label_seq_id/source_order disagreement sharing one order, and 1,2,4,5 gap -> NOT_MEASURED.

p2.fail_closed: When no authoritative source polymer sequence is mapped, LAW-105 is NOT_MEASURED with observed=None; returned coverage is None so the adjudicator fails closed to INDETERMINATE; the observed-only percentage is exposed only as observed_only_diagnostic_pct (never feeds the authoritative gate).
p2.downstream: main.py coverage_pct made None-safe; response schema coverage_pct is optional; runner.py coverage None-safe with source_backed basis.
p2.tests: test_missing_source_sequence_never_becomes_authoritative_pass asserts adjudicator INDETERMINATE; source-backed agreement tests preserved.

test_count.local: python -m pytest tests/ --q under PYTHONUTF8=1: 612 passed, 3 pre-existing baseline failures (protocol CRLF, matrix-hash drift x2).
test_count.note: Exact-SHA counts recorded here supersede prior stale evidence files (609/3, 605/3, older P1/P2/P5 counts).

limitations: Real 1PPE/5T4O and independent deposited-mmCIF fixtures remain unavailable; P1 regressions are synthetic. Full polymer-sequence alignment (SEQRES/entity-polymer) and one-to-one mapping validation remain open (P2 complete evidence).
